title: Qualify graceful hierarchy expansion and reversal
description: Six current specialists do not need managers by headcount alone. Exercise sustained-evidence proposals, process-change alternatives, owner approval and a bounded coordination pilot only if justified. Section 32 requires two domain managers coordinating a real task; current flat smoke does not meet it. Do not activate leads merely to claim readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposals own concrete integration outcomes and do not duplicate specialist ownership
Direct specialist communication remains available and program/fleet responsibilities stay separate
Approved pilot has measured success/stop conditions and preserves work on reversal
